test.test_id: one synthetic consultation completes capture, review, approval, and JSON export

environment.browser: Playwright Chromium with fake microphone device; scripted local non-ASR server

fixture.kind: manifest-verified public-mock synthetic dataset audio, padded to enable scripted browser capture

journey: record fixture through fake microphone and transcribe with scripted adapter
verify unresolved structured-field disagreement blocks approval
correct the fact, attribute manual addition, and reach final review
reconfirm identifiers, approve exact saved version, and export JSON
limitations: This scripted test uses prerecorded public-mock audio and a non-ASR browser adapter; it is not a live clinical speech-model evaluation.
The capture is a short browser journey, not a continuous 20–30-minute recording or hardware endurance test.
The approval event is generated in an isolated synthetic test workspace and is not clinical sign-off.
The test does not establish clinical accuracy, clinician time savings, privacy approval, EHR certification, or production readiness.

Two exploratory runs against earlier revisions of this new test failed on brittle test assertions; the committed revision passed this fresh run. Earlier attempts are preserved under separate ignored data output paths.
